decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Mega Gengar. Turn one job: Aerodactyl provides immediate fast Taunt or Tailwind to deny opposing setup, while Gengar Mega Evolves to activate Shadow Tag, trapping high-value targets and threatening status or chip. Backline: Scarf Krookodile brings Intimidate and outspeeds Noivern/Archaludon to deal high Ground damage with High Horsepower, while Clefable provides Follow Me redirection to keep Mega Gengar and Krookodile safe from single-target attacks.

TYPE CORRECTIONS: Rock Slide is NEUTRAL on Scizor (Rock SE Bug × NVE Steel = 1x), HHP is NEUTRAL on Scizor (Ground NVE Bug × SE Steel = 1x), Close Combat is NEUTRAL on Scizor (Fighting NVE Bug × SE Steel = 1x). Archaludon resists Rock Slide (NVE) and Sludge Bomb (NVE) but is SE-hit by HHP, CC, and Flare Blitz (latter neutralized in rain). Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch SE on Clefable (Steel SE Fairy). Grimmsnarl takes SE from Gengar Sludge Bomb (Poison SE Fairy). If opponent brings Arcanine G3, prioritize rain uptime and Archaludon; keep Scizor away.

decisions.rationale: Aerodactyl is vulnerable to Fake Out and Bullet Punch. Switching Aerodactyl to Krookodile triggers Intimidate to soften Scizor's physical attacks while bringing in Choice Scarf speed. Mega Evolving Gengar activates Shadow Tag to trap both foes, while Sludge Bomb applies massive STAB super-effective pressure on Grimmsnarl before Light Screen can reduce its damage fully.

decisions.rationale: Fake Out (+3) flinches Aero before Tailwind and voids Focus Sash. Bullet Punch (+1, SE 2x) on now-damaged Aero has real KO chance (36-102%). If Aero dies, it's 2v1 vs Gengar alone. Grimmsnarl likely falls to Mega Gengar Sludge Bomb regardless of Bullet Punch target, so maximize value by hunting the Aero KO. Mega Evolving Scizor now boosts Attack/Def for immediate and future turns.
decisions.notebook: G2 T1: Mega Gengar Sludge Bomb does 99-162% to Grimmsnarl — near-guaranteed OHKO. Base Gengar does 78.7-134.1%. Fake Out only works T1 (first turn active). Bullet Punch (Tech+STAB=90BP) SE 2x on Aero does 36-102% at ~95% HP — Focus Sash voided by Fake Out chip. Scizor-Mega BP range 95-127 Speed. Opponent Gengar likely Megas T1 for Shadow Tag. If Grimmsnarl falls, bring Politoed for rain (supports Archaludon, cuts Fire). KEY: preventing Aero Tailwind is top priority — with Tailwind both foes hit 330-400 Spe, untouchable without priority.

decisions.rationale: Politoed is the safe bring. Archaludon is 2x weak to both High Horsepower and Close Combat from an unlocked Choice Scarf Krookodile at 62% — too risky to send in. Politoed sets rain (Weather Ball→Water 2x SE on Krookodile), is neutral to Krookodile's entire moveset, and can support Scizor with Helping Hand or scout with Protect. Rain also weakens Fire for later Archaludon safety.
decisions.notebook: G2 T1: Grimmsnarl fainted to Gengar-Mega Sludge Bomb (SE OHKO). Krookodile was flinched by Fake Out T1 so Choice Scarf is NOT locked — it can pick any move T2. Scizor-Mega Atk -1 from Intimidate. Gengar-Mega Shadow Tag active (no voluntary switches). Politoed rain: Weather Ball becomes Water 100BP STAB, 2x SE on Krookodile Ground. Archaludon weak to Krookodile Ground+Fighting (both 2x). KEY: prevent Aero Tailwind; Politoed IceBeam 4x on Aero (Rock/Flying). Scizor Close Combat 2x SE on Krookodile (Fighting vs Dark). Opponent bench: Aero (FocusSash, Tailwind/WideGuard/RockSlide/Taunt), Clefable (Unaware, FollowMe), Arcanine (Intimidate, FlareBlitz/ESpeed/Snarl/WillOWisp), Empoleon (Competitive, LifeOrb).

decisions.rationale: Krookodile is threatened by Politoed's Rain-boosted Weather Ball and Scizor's Bullet Punch. Switching Krookodile to Clefable safely absorbs the incoming water and steel attacks with Clefable's bulk and Sitrus Berry. Meanwhile, Gengar-Mega's Shadow Tag traps both foes; landing Will-O-Wisp on Scizor-Mega permanently neutralizes its physical offense at -1 Attack, creating a long-term win condition against a trapped target.

This guarantees Gengar-Mega can safely execute Will-O-Wisp into Scizor-Mega, permanently burning it while Shadow Tag traps both foes on the field.

Krookodile (Scarf 216) and Aerodactyl (200) both outspeed Archaludon (max 137) and Scizor (max 127). High Horsepower deals 56.9-95.8% to Archaludon before it can attack. Aerodactyl's Rock Slide chips both foes and offers a 30% flinch chance on Archaludon, which would completely invalidate its attack. Burned -1 Atk Scizor poses no immediate lethality to either of our Pokémon.

Must KO Krookodile first (only Draco Meteor KOs it; Electro Shot immune, Flash Cannon NVE). Protecting preserves 100% HP for turn 7 Draco Meteor, forces Krookodile's Scarf lock, and dodges the 30% Rock Slide flinch. Scizor Bullet Punches Aerodactyl for priority chip, improving the eventual -2 SpA Flash Cannon KO range (~58% HP instead of 63%). After Krookodile falls, Archaludon Flash Cannons Aerodactyl at -2 SpA for the win.
decisions.notebook: Electro Shot = 2-turn charge move; 1-turn only in rain. Rain ending T6 means Electro Shot unusable T7+. Flash Cannon (80 BP STAB Steel) KOs Aerodactyl from 63% without rain dependency. Draco Meteor KOs Krookodile from 62% but drops SpA -2, making subsequent Flash Cannon ~45-103% (not guaranteed). Archaludon cannot win 1v1 vs Scarf Krookodile at low HP (Krook outspeeds, CC does 54.5%+). Win path: Protect T6 → Draco Meteor Krook T7 at 100% HP → Flash Cannon Aero T8 at -2 SpA. Scizor Bullet Punch chips Aero to improve KO odds. Aerodactyl Focus Sash already broken (at 63%). Krookodile has no Protect (Choice Scarf).

decisions.rationale: At -2 Atk and burned, Scizor-Mega's Bullet Punch deals only ~16-23% to 31% Aerodactyl and Close Combat deals ~17-21% to 62% Krookodile, so neither active foe can KO either of our Pokémon this turn. Krookodile (216 Speed) acts before Archaludon (max 137 Speed) to hit High Horsepower for 57-96% damage at +0 Def. Aerodactyl (200 Speed) follows with Rock Slide to chip Archaludon, lower Scizor into burn KO range, and add a 30% flinch chance.

decisions.rationale: Bullet Punch priority KOs Aerodactyl before it acts. Krook must HH Archaludon (survives 5–35%). Draco Meteor hits Krook at 62% for 53–121.8% (~87.5% KO). If KO, instant 2v0 win. If not, Krook at <9% and either BP or a -2 SpA Draco Meteor finishes next turn. Only risk is 90% accuracy. Best expected value.

Scizor Bullet Punch guaranteed KO on Aero from 30% via priority+Technician+STAB+SE. Krook HH does 64.7-94.6% to Archaludon (survives). Scizor Atk effective ~55 after -2 stages+burn; physical attacks very weak except priority BP. Opponent has no switches available (only Krook+Aero remain). Win path: BP KO Aero + Draco Meteor KO/cripple Krook → clean up next turn.

reflections.summary: Bringing Mega Gengar and Aerodactyl into Mega Scizor and Archaludon left the lead core completely vulnerable to Bullet Punch priority and Life Orb Stamina Archaludon's defense boosts, leaving Choice Scarf Krookodile unable to secure the late-game KO.
reflections.adjustment: Abandon the Mega Gengar and Aerodactyl lead plan against this opponent; bring a bulkier core that mitigates Bullet Punch priority and neutralizes Archaludon with special moves or ground/fire pressure before Stamina stacks.

reflections.summary: Won via priority Bullet Punch from burned Scizor-Mega cleaning up Aerodactyl while Archaludon's Draco Meteor finished Krookodile. The four-brought team plan worked: Grimmsnarl screens + Politoed rain enabled early tempo, and Scizor-Mega's Technician priority was the correct Mega for this opponent's frail, speed-dependent core. Zero decision errors; the win was earned through clean execution of the established win path.
reflections.adjustment: Scizor-Mega was heavily compromised by burn and Intimidate drops, leaving it nearly useless outside of Bullet Punch. Consider leading or positioning to avoid Gengar's Will-O-Wisp in future games, or pair Scizor with a more reliable secondary physical threat so the team isn't solely dependent on priority cleanup after status lands.
reflections.notebook: Series over: won 2-0. Opponent brought Gengar-Mega/Aerodactyl/Clefable/Krookodile; benched Arcanine/Empoleon. Krookodile is Choice Scarf Intimidate (Adamant). Aerodactyl runs Focus Sash + Tailwind/Wide Guard support. Gengar-Mega carries Will-O-Wisp and Sludge Bomb (poison chance). Clefable is Unaware Follow Me redirect. Opponent favors speed control + redirect + Scarf cleaner archetypes. Scizor-Mega Bullet Punch is reliable priority KO tool but burn + Intimidate stacking can neutralize it entirely. Archaludon Draco Meteor is viable emergency KO option even without rain. Politoed rain reliance is a liability if it falls before enabling Electro Shot.
